correctness.rationale: Direct exhaustive subgroup enumeration (59 A5, 156 S5), canonical simultaneous conjugation of strict chains, quotient face maps, integer boundary-square checks and explicit free-face collapse certificates establish the exact residual complexes. The A5 residue is a connected 5-cycle; the S5 residue is a connected closed triangulated 2-manifold with Euler characteristic 2, hence S2. Computation was successfully rerun from the standalone file and embedded certificate. No sampling/infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: This completely determines homotopy types for the natural two conjugation-quotient inclusion-chain spaces of the first nonabelian simple alternating group and its ambient full symmetric group, with an actual circle-to-sphere contrast. The geometric quotient requires chain-level simultaneous conjugacy and cannot be recovered from a subgroup conjugacy-class table; the result identifies integral homotopy types rather than only Euler/homology and uses no arbitrary parameter slice.
